title: Learned eleven-gene melanoma score associates with survival in public expression cohorts
summary: A penalized survival-model pipeline produced an eleven-gene melanoma score associated with observed survival in public expression cohorts. Model selection used both internal testing and an additional cohort, so the latter is not an untouched external test. The result is a retrospective prognostic association; it does not establish novel cell types, causal tumor biology or improved treatment decisions.
ai_technology: Scissor phenotype-linked feature selection followed by LASSO Cox and ridge survival modeling
organization: Zhejiang University; Harbin Genars Technology; GenVista Technology

evidence.tested: The source linked single-cell data to bulk survival data using Scissor, derived prognosis-related gene sets and compared seventy-two model combinations. It selected a LASSO Cox/ridge eleven-gene score using average performance across testing datasets. The paper reports a survival-group association in GSE65904, described as 215 samples, with modest time-dependent discrimination.
evidence.unknown: Outcome-informed upstream filtering and use of testing cohorts to choose the final model compromise independent validation. The paper reports 469 available TCGA records but a different final subgroup count in discussion, without a reconstructed participant flow here. Reported survival-time labels differ between text and figure captions, so exact time-specific AUCs are not adopted. Single-cell cluster labels, including the claimed MITF-positive T-cell population, were not independently authenticated as new biological cell types. Many individual genes already have melanoma associations. No causal mechanism, treatment benefit or clinical decision utility was demonstrated.
evidence.ai_role: Phenotype-linked selection and penalized learned survival modeling combined expression measurements into the represented score, enabling observed survival stratification beyond generic clustering or pathway enrichment.

source_review.scope: Read actual clinical dataset, Scissor/feature/clustering and penalized model-selection Methods, final eleven-gene score and survival Results. Novel cell-type identity and causal biology are not adjudicated or admitted. Cohort-accounting and time-label inconsistencies are retained explicitly; no untouched external test claimed. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
